SEPTIC ARTHRITIS (NATIVE JOINT) WITH STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS

Administer parenteral therapy initially for approximately two weeks

then can be converted to appropriate oral therapy.

Total duration of treatment 4-6 weeks depending on clinical response

# ________________________________________________________

# Methicillin-SUSCEPTIBLE Staphylococcus aureus

# ________________________________________________________

# Treatment

[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID \($\) R,DI](psozid2-tmp-sulfa-28days-1ds-tab-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-tmp-sulfa-28days-1ds-tab-bid)

[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO BID \($\) R](psozid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-28ds)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-bid-28days)
